summary: All three coaching-ui needs_operator items are decided, built and shown working (L6) on UAT in a headless-Chrome walk of the deployed app, with DB and API read-back. (1) PERSON-NAME-V2: a machine handle (hkpl_<hex>) is no longer treated as a name in either field. lib/person is now the one owner of that rule and the coaching-only personLabel workaround is gone. The response step every engine answer goes through cleans handles the engine packed into name fields or wrote into text. Walking as the coach, a name-less account showed 3 handles on screen before and 0 after. (2) GROUP-PRICE-V1: someone booking into a group slot pays the group band, and the confirm sheet says so in plain words. The engine locks exactly the quoted price or books nothing. A private rate only applies after the coach agrees it with the student, never automatically. The first booker into an empty group slot was locked at the private HKD 200 before and the group HKD 120 after (DB). (3) Signed-out visitors can browse a lesson slot, the Lessons hub and a coach profile. Tapping Book asks them to sign in and sends them back to the slot.

pricing.decision: A student booking into a GROUP slot pays the band the booking lands in, and never less than the smallest group band. They pay the group rate they chose, never the private rate. The price is locked at booking. If the slot ends up private, nothing raises it: the coach agrees the private rate with the student first. There is no automatic solo-band charge.
pricing.chose_because: G15.0: Reclub's floor is a flat per-player meet fee that nobody is re-charged. Our research (D:\Downloads\GRIPBAT_COACHING_RESEARCH.md §3, drawn from CourtReserve, Playtomic Academy and Mindbody-style tables) says the per-person price is fixed at the tier the student books into and never re-priced live, because live re-pricing confuses students and breaks manual payment reconciliation. The coaching-v1 rule (first booker pays the solo band) was the one case where a student could be surprised. This choice is the clearest for the student (the price shown is the price paid) and the least work for the coach: no difference to refund when the group fills, and a private rate is a conversation the app points them to.
pricing.confirm_sheet_line_en: You pay HKD 120 now. If this runs as a private lesson the coach will confirm the private rate with you first.
pricing.confirm_sheet_line_zh_Hant: 你現在支付 HKD 120。如果這堂課變成私人課，教練會先與你確認私人課價錢。
pricing.coach_private_hint: Only 1 booked — if this runs as a private lesson, agree the private rate (HKD 200) with your student first. They booked at the group rate.  [+ 'Message Amy Chan' → /pages/chat/index?user=<id>]
pricing.never_auto_charges_solo: No code path raises agreedPrice after booking. bookSingle also caps a race at the quoted price (price > quotedPrice -> quotedPrice).
pricing.also_fixed: coaches/lessons/book sent its coach:* refusals through the meet error mapper, which doesn't know them, so they came back as 500s. They now use the coach error catalogue (COACH_PRICE_CHANGED shows as a 400).

signed_out.decision: YES, signed-out visitors can browse (operator). A lesson slot, the Lessons hub ('Lessons you can book', one row per slot from the public Discover list) and a coach profile all show without sign-in. Every booking action (Book, Subscribe weekly, Buy a pack) opens 'Sign in to book' and returns to the slot after sign-in.
signed_out.chose_because: G15.0: Playtomic, Mindbody and Calendly all show the schedule and price publicly and ask for an account at booking. Reclub supports anonymous sessions (labels.txt:1426 'Called logOut but the current user is anonymous.'), which sets the floor. The demo promises 'no sign-in needed to look around'. A prompt with a way back beats a silent redirect because the visitor does not lose the slot they picked.
signed_out.gate: coachingEnabled() works signed out. It first asks Misskey's native POST /api/endpoint {endpoint:'coaches/schedules/of-user'}: 204 = no coaching module, so dark. It then asks the public coaches/schedules/of-user anonymously: 200 = on, 404 COACH_NOT_AVAILABLE = off (engine COACH-GATE-V1). It fails closed. No console error on any host: measured 0 on UAT hub + More, and 0 on prod More and hub after this change. The earlier schedules/show probe answered 400 and the plain of-user probe answered 404 on prod; both logged errors and both were replaced.
